Definition: from G4721; to roof over, i.e. (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently):--(for-)bear, suffer.
BiblicalUsage: To cover is to bear without breaking. Love beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things; Paul says when we could no longer forbear we thought it good to be left at Athens alone; and he suffered all things lest he should hinder the gospel of Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love bears what it could expose, and the apostle bore the cost so the gospel would not be hindered.
